{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs/task-7e1c6a1e.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    # The three adjacent non-zero cells on the top row are the color anchors.
    anchors = [(0, c, out[0][c]) for c in range(w - 2)
               if all(out[0][j] != 0 for j in range(c, c + 3))]
    if not anchors:
        return out
    anchors = anchors[0:3]
    for ar, ac, color in anchors:
        markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                   if out[r][c] == color and not (r == ar and c == ac)]
        if markers:
            mr, mc = markers[0]
            # Connect the anchor to its matching remote marker: down its
            # anchor column, then horizontally along the marker's row.
            step = 1 if mr >= ar else -1
            for r in range(ar, mr + step, step):
                out[r][ac] = color
            step = 1 if mc >= ac else -1
            for c in range(ac, mc + step, step):
                out[mr][c] = color
        else:
            # The middle anchor has no remote marker; extend its ray to the edge.
            for r in range(ar, h):
                out[r][ac] = color
    return out
"
}
